company.shortDescription: E-Tips is a digital tipping platform that offers cashless gratuity payments for service workers through QR codes and online payment methods.
company.description: E-Tips is a fintech platform focused on digital tipping and cashless gratuity management for hospitality and service industries. The company provides QR code–based payment solutions that allow customers to send tips electronically to employees using mobile payment methods. Its platform is designed for businesses such as restaurants, hotels, salons, and delivery services, helping them manage tip distribution, track transactions, and reduce reliance on cash payments.
